question: Explain the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 regarding dividend that has been declared but not paid or claimed.
sources: Companies Act, 2013 - section 124 unpaid dividend account
Companies Act, 2013 - section 125 Investor Education and Protection Fund
Companies Act, 2013 - section 127 failure to distribute dividends

points.label: Time to pay
points.description: A declared dividend must be paid, or the warrant posted, within thirty days of the date of declaration.

points.label: Transfer to Unpaid Dividend Account
points.description: Any amount not paid or claimed within those thirty days must be moved within the next seven days to a special 'Unpaid Dividend Account' opened in a scheduled bank.

points.label: Statement on website
points.description: The company must prepare a statement of the names, addresses and unpaid amounts of the shareholders concerned and place it on its website and any other website the Government specifies.

points.label: Transfer to IEPF
points.description: Money lying in the Unpaid Dividend Account for seven years from the date of transfer is moved to the Investor Education and Protection Fund.

points.label: Transfer of shares and claims
points.description: Shares on which dividend has been unpaid or unclaimed for seven consecutive years are also transferred to the Fund; the shareholder can still claim the shares and amounts back from the Fund.
